ActiveTurnState.description:
Durable nonterminal state of one logical Agent Turn.

Terminal truth belongs exclusively to the terminal Agent event, so this enum intentionally has no completed or failed variants.

AgentAssistantText.description: Agent-authored user-visible text with an explicit presentation phase.

AgentContextCompaction.description: Typed context-compaction progress or final outcome.

AgentContextCompactionDelta.description: Incremental typed update for a context-compaction block.

AgentEvent.description: Canonical append-only fact emitted during one logical Agent Turn.

AgentEventPayload.description: Closed union of canonical Agent Turn lifecycle events.

AgentExecutionSummary.description: Bounded execution summary produced during one Agent Turn.

AgentInterruptOutcome.description: Observable result of exact Turn cancellation and cleanup settlement.

AgentMediaSource.description: Exact source of one submitted media content item.

AgentMessage.description: Canonical message shared by Agent execution, history, protocol, and SDK.

AgentMessageBlock.description: One typed lifecycle block inside an Agent message.

AgentMessageBlockCompleted.description: Completed snapshot of one block inside an existing message.

AgentMessageBlockContent.description: Closed union of content that can appear in canonical Agent history.

AgentMessageBlockDelta.description: Incremental typed update for one running message block.

AgentMessageBlockDeltaContent.description: Closed union of incremental block updates accepted by the reducer.

AgentMessageBlockStarted.description: Started snapshot of one block inside an existing message.

AgentMessageBlockStatus.description: Lifecycle status of one Agent message block.

AgentMessageRole.description: Author of one canonical Agent message.

AgentMessageStarted.description: Started snapshot of one canonical Agent message.

AgentMessageStatus.description: Lifecycle status of one canonical Agent message.

AgentPath.description:
Canonical logical address of one node inside a Primary Session Agent tree.

This type owns path parsing and ancestry rules. Session IDs remain the durable execution identity and must not be inferred from this path.

AgentPendingInput.description: Typed input required before the logical Turn can continue.

AgentReasoning.description: Model reasoning content safe to expose through the Agent API.

AgentRunFailure.description: Canonical failed Turn result preserving visible partial output.

AgentRunMetrics.description: Aggregated execution metrics that do not duplicate terminal outcome.

context.description: Last measured model context window after this invocation.

AgentRunOutput.description: Canonical successful Turn result derived by Harness from one reducer.

AgentRunResult.description: Unique completed or failed result of one logical Agent Turn.

AgentSystemNotice.description: Typed system notice emitted as part of Agent execution history.

AgentToolCall.description: Typed Tool invocation emitted by an Agent Provider.

AgentToolCallArguments.description: Structured lifecycle of streamed Tool arguments.

AgentToolCallArgumentsDelta.description: Incremental JSON fragment for one Tool call argument object.

AgentToolProgress.description: One typed progress observation for a running Tool call.

AgentToolResult.description: Typed Tool result linked to one Tool invocation by `call_id`.

AgentTreeNode.description: One Agent tree node and its direct child nodes.

AgentTreeSnapshot.description: One recursively nested Agent tree projected from durable child Sessions.

AgentTurnCompleted.description: Successful terminal metadata for one logical Turn.

AgentTurnFailed.description: Failed terminal metadata for one logical Turn.

retryable.description: Runtime-owned retry policy; not part of the reusable public error object.

AgentTurnRef.description:
Canonical exact reference to one logical Session Turn.

Service, Agent execution, events, persistence, protocols, and collaboration reuse this value instead of defining boundary-specific identity objects.

AgentTurnStarted.description: Marker payload for the unique start of one logical Turn.

AgentUserContent.description: Ordered User-authored content accepted by every Turn input API.

AgentUserInput.description: Untrusted typed content submitted by an Agent API caller.

CollaborationToolResult.description:
Canonical strongly typed result emitted by collaboration Tools.

Generic Tool transport may serialize this enum once, but business and presentation consumers must decode this tagged contract rather than select a result shape from the Tool name.

ComputerListRequest.description: Selectable Computers for the caller, including the existing shared embedded node.

ContextCompactionMetrics.description: Public metrics for a context compaction maintenance item.

ContextCompactionOutcome.description: Terminal result of a context compaction maintenance item.

ContextCompactionStage.description: Current stage of a context compaction timeline item.

ContextCompactionTrigger.description: Reason a run entered the context compaction maintenance stage.

ContextUsage.description: Last successfully measured model-context usage for a Session.

CreateNodeRequest.description: Creates a node with a control-plane-generated, immutable UUID.

DesktopConnectionMode.description: Product connection source, independent of the server deployment mode.

nodeId.description: Explicit UUID for credential recovery. Omitted/null enrolls or reuses saved identity.

DynamicToolResult.description: Result submitted by an external Dynamic Tool consumer.

DynamicToolResultParams.description: Parameters for an existing Dynamic Tool result request.

ErrorCode.description:
Public application error code shared by server and SDKs.

This enum is the single source of truth for client-visible application error semantics. Transport adapters may map codes to protocol-specific envelopes or status codes, but they must not add new application semantics.

ErrorLocalization.description: Exact business explanations with real localized consumers. Extend only when a domain has a stable, parameterized message; never add arbitrary translation keys, diagnostic data, or presentation policy here.

FileContentResponse.description: Wire response for authenticated file content; SDKs decode bytes for callers.

FileDeleteRequest.description: Selects one file to delete for the authenticated user.

FileDeleteResponse.description: Confirms the identifier of a deleted file.

FileInfo.description: Public metadata for one authenticated user's ready file.

FileListRequest.description: Filters one authenticated user's files with opaque cursor pagination.

FileListResponse.description: Returns one page of ready files and the next opaque cursor.

FileReadRequest.description: Selects one file owned by the authenticated user.

FileReadResponse.description: Returns public metadata for one ready file.

FileScope.description: Selects whether a file is personal or restricted to one project context.

FileUpdateRequest.description: Replaces selected mutable metadata on one ready file.

FileUpdateResponse.description: Returns public metadata after a successful file update.

FileUploadParams.description: App Server upload envelope; other file methods use shared request objects directly.

FileUploadRequest.description: Describes metadata supplied alongside one streamed file upload.

FileUploadResponse.description: Returns the ready file created by an upload.
